title: Antifascist counter-demonstration in Innsbruck’s Walther-Park
reason: No demand directed at the Austrian government or its policy is established
notes: ORF reports a separately registered antifascist demonstration of 80, arranged in the vicinity of the anti-COVID demonstration; it says organizers did not expect a meeting with the COVID-protest crowd. The article does not report that the counter-demonstration made a domestic state demand. Its reported crowd exceeds 50, but the state-target criterion remains unsupported.
